verses.1: Unto the end. In verses, the understanding of David.
verses.2: Listen to my prayer, O God, and despise not my supplication.
verses.3: Be attentive to me, and heed me. I have been grieved in my training, and I have been disturbed
verses.4: at the voice of the adversary and at the tribulation of the sinner. For they have diverted iniquities toward me, and they have been harassing me with rage.
verses.5: My heart has become disturbed within me, and the dread of death has fallen over me.
verses.6: Fear and trembling have overwhelmed me, and darkness has buried me.
verses.7: And I said, “Who will give me wings like the dove, so that I may fly away and take rest?”
verses.8: Behold, I have fled far away, and I linger in solitude.
verses.9: I waited for him who saved me from a weak-minded spirit and from a tempest.
verses.10: Cast them down, O Lord, and divide their tongues. For I have seen iniquity and contradiction in the city.
verses.11: Day and night, iniquity will surround it upon its walls, and hardship is in its midst,
verses.12: with injustice. And usury and deceit have not fallen away from its streets.
verses.13: For if my enemy had spoken evil about me, certainly, I would have sustained it. And if he who hated me had been speaking great things against me, I would perhaps have hidden myself from him.
verses.14: Truly, you are a man of one mind: my leader and my acquaintance,
verses.15: who took sweet food together with me. In the house of God, we walked side-by-side.
verses.16: Let death come upon them, and let them descend alive into Hellfire. For there is wickedness in their dwellings, in their midst.
verses.17: But I have cried out to God, and the Lord will save me.
verses.18: Evening and morning and midday, I will discourse and announce, and he will heed my voice.
verses.19: He will redeem my soul in peace from those who draw near to me. For, among the many, they were with me.
verses.20: God will hear, and He who is before time will humble them. For there is no change with them, and they have not feared God.
verses.21: He has stretched forth his hand in retribution. They have contaminated his covenant.
verses.22: They were divided by the wrath of his countenance, and his heart has drawn near. His words are smoother than oil, and they are arrows.
verses.23: Cast your cares upon the Lord, and he will nurture you. He will not allow the just to be tossed about forever.
verses.24: Truly, O God, you will lead them away into the well of death. Bloody and deceitful men will not divide their days in half. But I will hope in you, O Lord. [ Psalm 55 ] (56)
